addedCapabilities.name: Nested repeater parent scope
addedCapabilities.change: Forwarded default slots preserve an already scoped locals.node; inner child inputs attach to their current group rather than the repeater.
addedCapabilities.proof: Baseline created inner text with no proper parent/value; candidate renders One, adds/edit Two, adds independent outer rows. Passed real Chromium nested editing.

addedCapabilities.name: Section DOM refs and explicit callback refs
addedCapabilities.change: Populate __fkSectionRefs from schema meta.section; exclude iterated sections; honor explicit ref callbacks; clear refs on structural removal/destruction.
addedCapabilities.proof: Contract regression failed before patch and passes after; matches installed React 2.5 section-ref behavior.

addedCapabilities.name: False ARIA states
addedCapabilities.change: Serialize false aria-* values as the literal false string instead of removing the attribute.
addedCapabilities.proof: Literal/reactive regression passes; real Chromium axe aria-required-attr combobox violations disappear.

addedCapabilities.name: Default Genesis class compatibility
addedCapabilities.change: Normalize default section classes with upstream kebab(). Explicit user rootClasses remain supported.
addedCapabilities.proof: Default class regression and class-config checks pass; real Chromium now uses official local Genesis styles without a fixture rootClasses override.

addedCapabilities.name: Document and ShadowRoot propagation
addedCapabilities.change: Provide host DOM root as __root to root/field nodes before Core creation, including ignored children.
addedCapabilities.proof: Document/ShadowRoot creation-time contract passes; real browser color focus error disappears and swatch canvas changes to RGBA [0,255,0,255].

Real native keyboard, mouse, popover, canvas, touch geometry, focus retention and 25 repeated mount/unmount cycles were exercised. Manual screen-reader behavior, all device/engine combinations and complete accessibility are not established.

Performance is a one-arm steady-state diagnostic on shared hardware; module/style startup cached, no comparative ratios, no performance superiority claim.

componentInventoryConclusion: All 14 current Pro exports are schema factories with no exported component definition/library requirement. Their normal dependency tree supplies drag-and-drop and tempo. The implemented gaps concern adapter ownership, DOM root/refs and semantic rendering, not invented replacement components.
